blocks.title: ABOUT
blocks.lede: An elite athletic development centre in Fortitude Valley, built on evidence-based coaching and a passion for long-term athletic development.

blocks.heading: WHY ATHLETIX?
blocks.lede: Hear from our founders on why we built ATHLETIX and the mission that drives every coach on the floor.

items.title: Train Like an Athlete
items.body:
Founded in 2021 by Marco Mastrorocco and Jovan Vucetic, ATHLETIX is on a mission to become the **number one private high-performance facility in Australia**.

We are committed to **training everyone like athletes**, bridging the high-performance model to **regular people**, *not exclusively to athletes*.

items.title: What We Do
items.body:
At ATHLETIX, we specialise in:

- **Strength and conditioning** training
- **Athlete training programs**
- Unique, evidence-based **group fitness classes**
- Long-term **athlete development (LTAD) pathways for youth athletes**
- **In-house sports rehabilitation programs**
- Coaching **professional athletes**
- Supporting the physical preparedness for any sport

items.title: Why We Are Different
items.body:
ATHLETIX stands out by integrating **high-performance training principles into every client's program**, regardless of their athletic background. Our approach is rooted in **evidence-based practices**, and we are dedicated to delivering personalized, high-quality coaching that drives results.

We foster a community where both elite athletes and general fitness enthusiasts can achieve their goals through scientifically backed training methods.

items.title: Our Philosophy
items.body:
> We believe in creating strong and resilient individuals capable of withstanding sport demands and living a pain-free life.

Our passion for **youth development** drives our focus on sound **LTAD principles** and our opposition to early sport specialisation. We emphasise building solid competencies through a **systematic approach to training**. Our coaches are responsible for running programs that align with the ATHLETIX brand, ensuring that every client receives the highest standard of care and expertise.

blocks.title: Our Approach to Youth Training
blocks.body: Hear our founders on the Australian Strength & Conditioning Association podcast on how we apply LTAD principles, build robust youth athletes, and stay clear of early sport specialisation.

blocks.heading: THE ATHLETIX S&C TEAM
blocks.lede: ATHLETIX is made up of an exceptionally talented team of professionals. Our coaches blend higher education (Exercise Science, Human Movement, Physiotherapy degrees) with practical on-the-field experience — training elite athletes, general population and clinical patients.

blocks.body: Every Athletix coach holds dual accreditation from Australia's two peak national bodies — ASCA and ESSA. University degrees merged with real on-field experience at the highest level of Australian sport.

blocks.heading: Trusted by Brisbane's Elite Clubs & Institutions
blocks.tagline: The coaches and physios who work with **professional athletes** choose Athletix for their own players. If they trust us — you can too.
blocks.quote: "The same science, the same standards, the same care used by **NRL, cricket, and basketball clubs** — built into a facility where every kid, adult, and family in Brisbane can access it."
